verdict.rationale: Morph is an API/SDK platform providing models and tools (Fast Apply, Reflexes, Compact, WarpGrep) for developers to build their own coding agents or plug into third-party agents (Claude Code, Codex) — it is not itself an end-user product with a built-in assistant to delegate tasks to. The delegation-to-assistant story is a category mismatch for this kind of infrastructure/API offering.
